title: Editor panels read as Frequency type, and Vera can be put away
detail: Owner screenshot 2026-10-20: the editor inspector looked blocky with off fonts. Cause: the site theme aliases (data-website-theme) re-skinned the chrome, and Tailwind utilities in the shared field form beat the layered editor-shell rules. DONE 2026-10-21: unlayered Frequency-scoped rules pin the chrome to --fq tokens, give field labels, counters and hints their own hierarchy, lighten inputs and tidy layer rows. Vera has a Hide control in her bar; an orb stays bottom right, the choice is remembered on this device, Command K or the orb brings her back, Command backslash toggles. Renders in /mnt/project-files/editor/.

verify.cmd: node -e "const fs=require('fs');const c=fs.readFileSync('app/themes/frequency/editor-shell.css','utf8');const s=fs.readFileSync('components/sites/editor/shell.tsx','utf8');if(!/THE INSPECTOR AND LAYERS, REFINED/.test(c)||!/\.vera-orb/.test(c)||!/Hide Vera/.test(s))process.exit(1)"
verify.note: Passes while the refined inspector rules and the Hide Vera control exist.
